Enrich person.name: Nina Jordan Boynton
Enrich person.title: Fractional Executive - COO/Chief of Staff to Founder
Enrich person.summary:
I spent 20+ years inside the operations engine rooms of Wells Fargo, Truist, UBS, and Merrill Lynch building the process, risk, and governance infrastructure that lets billion-dollar financial businesses move fast without breaking. Now I bring that same discipline to clients, at the scale and speed they actually need.
 
I have been working alongside a fintech founder as Chief of Staff / emerging COO, helping him build the operational foundation his company needs to scale. That means translating what I learned managing heavily regulated, enterprise-scale operations into practical guardrails for a young company.  I am nimble, spotting the compliance and process hurdles before they become expensive problems, and building a stable operating rhythm underneath the growth.
  
I'm a Six Sigma Black Belt and certified Scrum Master who's spent a career turning messy operations into scalable systems: process design, workflow automation, risk and governance frameworks, KPI and dashboard visibility, and the team-building that makes all of it stick. I've done this at enterprise scale and I now do it fractionally, for founders who need that same rigor without a full-time enterprise hire.
  
Let's talk about what's slowing you down.
  
Enterprise Level Results: 
> Improved Wealth product and service capabilities within Merrill and UBS that eased Financial Advisor book growth and satisfied/delighted clients. 

> Aided CIT in the buildout of CCAR reporting functionality as the bank transformed into a GSIB (systematically important bank). 

> Modernized multiple business functions and technologies throughout career, allowing organizations to scale and service customers in innovative ways. 

> Successfully implemented automations and enhanced workflows leveraging Salesforce, Pega, ServiceNow, and Fidelity banking platforms, among other applications.

> At Wells Fargo and Truist, built risk management frameworks from the ground up.
